## Loading metadata

```{r}
#| warning: false

metadata <- readr::read_csv(file = input_exp_table)

# --input_exp_table is a per-sample METADATA table, not the alignment
# samplesheet: the shipped example (assets/samplesheets/test_meta_data.csv) is
# `sample,patient_id,timepoint,condition,batch` with no fastq columns at all.
# `select(-c(fastq_1, fastq_2))` therefore aborted with "Column `fastq_1`
# doesn't exist" for anyone following the documented format. Drop those columns
# only when a samplesheet was passed instead.
metadata <- metadata %>%
  select(-dplyr::any_of(c("sampleIndex", "fastq_1", "fastq_2", "fastq_3",
                          "modality", "run_id", "r1", "r2", "i1", "i2"))) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  as.data.frame()

if (!"sample" %in% colnames(metadata))
  stop("--input_exp_table must contain a `sample` column. Found: ",
       paste(colnames(metadata), collapse = ", "))

```

## Merging Seurat objects

```{r merge, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, echo = TRUE}

# Adjusting names
sample_label <- sub(
  '(\\S+)_seurat_object.RDS', '\\1', basename(input_qc_approved))

sample_label <- setNames(
  input_qc_approved,
  sample_label
)

# On-disk store for the per-sample BPCells matrices. Kept under data/ so it is
# published with the merged object.
bpcells_root <- file.path('data', 'bpcells')
if (dir.exists(bpcells_root)) unlink(bpcells_root, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(bpcells_root, recursive = TRUE)

# Read each QC-approved sample, prefix its barcodes, and persist its counts as
# an on-disk BPCells matrix. BPCells uses 64-bit indexing, so the joined matrix
# is NOT bound by the ~2.1 billion non-zero ceiling of an in-memory dgCMatrix
# (which caused the 'vector::reserve' failure in JoinLayers at cohort scale).
counts_list <- list()
meta_list   <- list()

for (label in names(sample_label)) {

  obj <- readRDS(file = sample_label[[label]])
  obj$raw_cell_id <- Cells(obj)
  obj <- RenameCells(obj, add.cell.id = label)

  counts <- SeuratObject::LayerData(obj, assay = 'RNA', layer = 'counts')

  mat_dir <- file.path(bpcells_root, label)
  BPCells::write_matrix_dir(mat = counts, dir = mat_dir, overwrite = TRUE)

  counts_list[[label]] <- BPCells::open_matrix_dir(dir = mat_dir)
  meta_list[[label]]   <- obj@meta.data

  rm(obj, counts); gc()
}

# Align to a common gene set (identical when samples share a reference) and
# column-bind the on-disk matrices into a single 64-bit-backed counts matrix.
gene_sets    <- lapply(counts_list, rownames)
common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, gene_sets)

if (!all(vapply(gene_sets, function(g) identical(g, common_genes), logical(1)))) {
  message(sprintf('Aligning samples to %d shared genes', length(common_genes)))
  counts_list <- lapply(counts_list, function(m) m[common_genes, ])
}

combined_counts <- do.call(cbind, counts_list)

# Consolidate the concatenated matrix into ONE on-disk store at a predictable
# relative path (data/bpcells_counts). Downstream steps stage this directory at
# the same relative location so the object's on-disk references resolve. Then
# drop the now-redundant per-sample stores.
counts_store <- file.path('data', 'bpcells_counts')
if (dir.exists(counts_store)) unlink(counts_store, recursive = TRUE)
BPCells::write_matrix_dir(mat = combined_counts, dir = counts_store)
combined_counts <- BPCells::open_matrix_dir(dir = counts_store)
unlink(bpcells_root, recursive = TRUE)

# Combined per-cell metadata (common columns; barcodes already made unique).
# Drop the auto-computed count columns so CreateSeuratObject regenerates them.
common_cols   <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(meta_list, colnames))
combined_meta <- do.call(rbind, lapply(meta_list, function(m) m[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]))
combined_meta <- combined_meta[, setdiff(colnames(combined_meta),
                                         c('nCount_RNA', 'nFeature_RNA')), drop = FALSE]

# One object with a single BPCells-backed counts layer: no in-memory
# JoinLayers/StitchMatrix is required, so the 32-bit ceiling never applies.
seurat_object <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts    = combined_counts,
  project   = project_name,
  meta.data = combined_meta
)

```

## Unifying sample layers

```{r seurat_rejoin}
#| code-fold: true

# The counts were column-bound into a single BPCells-backed layer above, so
# there is normally only one layer here and nothing to join. The guard remains
# so the notebook still behaves correctly if a multi-layer object is ever passed.
if (length(SeuratObject::Layers(seurat_object, assay = 'RNA')) > 1) {

  seurat_object <- JoinLayers(seurat_object)

}

```

## Adding metadata columns

```{r adding_metadata}

# Keeping cell idents
priviosional <- seurat_object@meta.data
priviosional$barcode <- row.names(priviosional)

priviosional <- merge(
  priviosional,
  metadata,
  by.x = "orig.ident",
  by.y = "sample"
)

rownames(priviosional) <- priviosional$barcode
priviosional$barcode <- NULL

# Adding metadata

seurat_object <- AddMetaData(
  object = seurat_object,
  metadata = priviosional
)

```

## Object summary {#object-summary}

```{r object-summary, results = 'asis'}
# What actually came out of the merge: dimensions, assays, layers, and which
# metadata columns downstream stages can key on. Without this the report says a
# merge happened but not what it produced, and a missing layer or a metadata
# column that silently vanished only surfaces as a crash three stages later.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(data.table)})
.assay <- tryCatch(Seurat::DefaultAssay(seurat_object), error = function(e) NA_character_)
.ncell <- ncol(seurat_object); .ngene <- nrow(seurat_object)
.layers <- tryCatch(SeuratObject::Layers(seurat_object), error = function(e) character(0))
.reds   <- tryCatch(names(seurat_object@reductions), error = function(e) character(0))

.summary <- data.table(
  property = c("cells", "features", "default assay", "assays", "layers", "reductions"),
  value = c(format(.ncell, big.mark = ","), format(.ngene, big.mark = ","),
            .assay,
            paste(tryCatch(names(seurat_object@assays), error = function(e) NA), collapse = ", "),
            if (length(.layers)) paste(.layers, collapse = ", ") else "none",
            if (length(.reds)) paste(.reds, collapse = ", ") else "none (added at the cluster stage)"))
scratch_table(.summary, caption = "Merged object")

# Metadata columns are the contract with every downstream stage: they are what
# --sample_col / --condition_col / --celltype_col resolve against.
.md <- seurat_object@meta.data
.mdt <- data.table(
  column = names(.md),
  type = vapply(.md, function(z) class(z)[1], ""),
  distinct = vapply(.md, function(z) length(unique(z)), integer(1)),
  missing = vapply(.md, function(z) sum(is.na(z)), integer(1)))
.mdt[, example := vapply(names(.md), function(n) {
  v <- .md[[n]][!is.na(.md[[n]])]
  if (!length(v)) return("")
  if (is.numeric(v)) sprintf("%.3g - %.3g", min(v), max(v))
  else paste(head(unique(as.character(v)), 3), collapse = ", ")
}, "")]
scratch_table(.mdt, caption = "Metadata columns available to downstream stages")

.empty <- .mdt[missing == nrow(.md)]$column
if (length(.empty)) scratch_finding(
  sprintf(paste("Metadata column(s) **%s** are entirely missing values. Any downstream",
                "stage keyed on them will silently produce empty groups rather than fail."),
          paste(.empty, collapse = ", ")),
  type = "caution", title = "Empty metadata columns")
```

```{r design-compute, include = FALSE}
# Nothing in this pipeline ever shows the experimental DESIGN, yet every
# condition-level result downstream depends on it: propeller, scCODA and the
# DE tests all need replicates within each group, and an unreplicated or
# unbalanced design invalidates them before a single test is run. This is the
# one report where that can be checked, because it is where samples first meet.
.dm <- as.data.table(seurat_object@meta.data)
.scol <- intersect(c("orig.ident","sample_id","sample","Samples"), names(.dm))[1]
# Candidate design factors: low-cardinality categoricals that are not the
# sample column itself and not per-cell measurements.
.design_cols <- character(0)
if (!is.na(.scol)) {
  for (nm in setdiff(names(.dm), .scol)) {
    v <- .dm[[nm]]
    if (is.numeric(v)) next
    k <- length(unique(v[!is.na(v)]))
    if (k >= 2 && k <= 12) .design_cols <- c(.design_cols, nm)
  }
  # Keep only columns constant WITHIN a sample -- those describe the sample,
  # not the cell (cluster or phase labels vary cell to cell and are not design).
  .design_cols <- Filter(function(nm)
    all(.dm[, .(k = length(unique(get(nm)))), by = .scol]$k == 1), .design_cols)
}
```

```{r design-finding, results = 'asis'}
if (is.na(.scol) || !length(.design_cols)) {
  scratch_finding(
    paste("No sample-level design factors were found in the metadata, so this cohort",
          "cannot support condition-level comparison. Differential abundance and",
          "differential expression need a grouping column that is constant within a",
          "sample -- supply one via `--input_exp_table`."),
    type = "caution", title = "Experimental design")
} else {
  .lvl <- unique(.dm[, c(.scol, .design_cols), with = FALSE])
  for (f in .design_cols) {
    .n <- .lvl[, .N, by = f]
    .minrep <- min(.n$N)
    msg <- sprintf("**%s**: %s (%s).", f,
                   paste(sprintf("%s = %d sample%s", .n[[f]], .n$N,
                                 ifelse(.n$N == 1, "", "s")), collapse = "; "),
                   sprintf("%d group%s", nrow(.n), ifelse(nrow(.n) == 1, "", "s")))
    if (nrow(.n) < 2) msg <- paste(msg,
      "Only one level is present, so this factor cannot be tested.")
    else if (.minrep < 2) msg <- paste(msg,
      "**At least one group has a single sample.** With no biological replicate in a",
      "group, differential abundance and differential expression cannot separate the",
      "condition effect from that one sample's idiosyncrasies -- any p-value from",
      "such a design is not interpretable.")
    else if (.minrep < 3) msg <- paste(msg,
      "Groups have as few as 2 samples; this is testable but underpowered, and",
      "pseudobulk methods will be sensitive to a single outlying sample.")
    scratch_finding(msg, type = if (nrow(.n) < 2 || .minrep < 2) "caution" else "note",
                    title = paste("Design:", f))
  }
  scratch_table(.lvl, caption = "Sample-level design")
}
```

```{r design-figure, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4
if (!is.na(.scol) && length(.design_cols)) {
  .f <- .design_cols[1]
  .dd <- .dm[, .(cells = .N), by = c(.scol, .f)]
  setnames(.dd, c("sample", "grp", "cells"))
  .dd[, tip := sprintf("%s\n%s: %s\n%s cells", sample, .f, grp,
                       format(cells, big.mark = ","))]
  ggplot(.dd, aes(reorder(sample, cells), cells, fill = grp, text = tip)) +
    geom_col(width = .7) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .12))) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = sprintf("Cohort design: samples by %s", .f),
         subtitle = "each bar is one biological sample; groups need >=2 samples to be testable",
         x = NULL, y = "cells", fill = .f) +
    theme_scratch()
}
```

## Post-merge cohort QC {#cohort-qc}

```{r cohort-qc-compute, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis'}
# Added because this notebook previously emitted ONE figure and no findings: it
# merged samples and said nothing about the result. A merge report should answer
# "did every sample survive, and is the cohort balanced?" before anything else.
#
# results='asis' is REQUIRED -- scratch_finding()/scratch_table() emit raw HTML,
# and in a normal chunk cat() output is wrapped in a verbatim block, so the
# callout markup renders as literal text.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(ggplot2); library(data.table)})

.md <- as.data.table(seurat_object@meta.data, keep.rownames = "cell_id")
.smp <- intersect(c("orig.ident","sample_id","sample","Samples"), names(.md))[1]
.summ <- NULL

if (is.na(.smp)) {
  cat("\n_No sample column found; cohort QC skipped._\n\n")
} else {
  .md[, .s := as.character(get(.smp))]
  .pick <- function(p) intersect(p, names(.md))[1]
  .cnt <- .pick(c("nCount_RNA","nCount")); .ftr <- .pick(c("nFeature_RNA","nFeature"))
  .mt  <- .pick(c("percent.mt","percent_mito","percent.mito"))

  # as.numeric() is load-bearing: median() on an integer column returns an
  # integer for odd-n groups and a double for even-n groups, and data.table
  # requires one type across groups -- otherwise this aborts on sample 2.
  .summ <- .md[, .(cells = .N), by = .s]
  if (!is.na(.cnt)) .summ <- merge(.summ, .md[, .(median_umi   = as.numeric(median(get(.cnt), na.rm=TRUE))), by=.s], by=".s")
  if (!is.na(.ftr)) .summ <- merge(.summ, .md[, .(median_genes = as.numeric(median(get(.ftr), na.rm=TRUE))), by=.s], by=".s")
  if (!is.na(.mt))  .summ <- merge(.summ, .md[, .(median_pct_mt = round(as.numeric(median(get(.mt), na.rm=TRUE)),2)), by=.s], by=".s")
  setnames(.summ, ".s", "sample"); setorder(.summ, -cells)

  # ---- computed verdict, not a caption -------------------------------------
  n_s   <- nrow(.summ); tot <- sum(.summ$cells)
  imbal <- max(.summ$cells) / max(1, min(.summ$cells))
  msg <- sprintf("Merged **%s cells** from **%d samples** (%s to %s cells per sample; %.1fx imbalance).",
                 format(tot, big.mark=","), n_s,
                 format(min(.summ$cells), big.mark=","), format(max(.summ$cells), big.mark=","), imbal)
  if (imbal >= 3) msg <- paste(msg,
    "A greater-than-3x cell-count imbalance biases any unweighted cohort comparison --",
    "prefer per-sample statistics, and check that clustering is not driven by sample identity.")
  if (!is.na(.mt) && any(.summ$median_pct_mt > 15)) msg <- paste(msg,
    sprintf("Sample(s) **%s** have median mitochondrial content above 15%%, indicating stressed or dying cells.",
            paste(.summ$sample[.summ$median_pct_mt > 15], collapse=", ")))
  if (!is.na(.ftr)) {
    .lo <- .summ$sample[.summ$median_genes < 500]
    if (length(.lo)) msg <- paste(msg,
      sprintf("Sample(s) **%s** have a median below 500 detected genes, which is low for droplet scRNA-seq.",
              paste(.lo, collapse=", ")))
  }
  scratch_finding(msg, type = if (imbal >= 3) "caution" else "note", title = "Cohort composition")
  scratch_table(.summ, caption = "Per-sample post-merge summary")
}
```

```{r cohort-qc-figure, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4
# NOTE: the ggplot must be this chunk's LAST VALUE, not wrapped in print().
# ggplot2 4.0 dispatches print() through S7, so an explicit print(p) bypasses
# knitr's knit_print hook and the figure renders as a static raster instead of
# an interactive widget. `if` returning the plot keeps auto-printing intact.
if (!is.null(.summ)) {
  # `text` drives the plotly tooltip; without it ggplotly builds a hover string
  # out of the raw aes expressions ("reorder(sample, cells): ...").
  .summ[, tip := sprintf("%s\n%s cells (%.1f%% of cohort)",
                         sample, format(cells, big.mark=","), 100*cells/sum(cells))]
  ggplot(.summ, aes(reorder(sample, cells), cells, fill = cells, text = tip)) +
    geom_col(width = .7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = format(cells, big.mark=",")), hjust = -.15, size = 3.2) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#cde2fb", high = "#0d366b", guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .18))) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = "Cells retained per sample after QC",
         subtitle = sprintf("%s cells across %d samples",
                            format(sum(.summ$cells), big.mark=","), nrow(.summ)),
         x = NULL, y = "cells") +
    theme_scratch()
}
```
